image_digest_scope: Recorded by original producer on the encoded bytes decoded for inference. This independent CPU audit does not reread the source images or reconstruct a per-image list.
packet_digest_scope: The original producer asserted per-frame unavailable detections equal fresh RGB. Detection packets were not persisted; their rolling digests cannot be independently reconstructed here.
literal_MOT_hash_scope: Excludes confidence but retains original row order and literal IDs/boxes. Different hashes are software output differences, not accuracy or association-quality improvements.
